title: aspidium triglossum
intro: Aspidium triglossum, commonly known as the Indian maidenhair fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the Aspidium genus. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of Aspidium triglossum include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as bronchodilation, antimicrobial activity, and antioxidant effects. Furthermore, the plant is also used in traditional medicine for its potential therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, immunomodulatory, and hepatoprotective effects.
